name: Grupa Pracuj S.A.
summary: Operating within the digital job market, Grupa Pracuj S.A. serves clients in both Poland and Ukraine. The company manages a diverse portfolio of online platforms, such as Pracuj.pl and Robota.ua, which are general recruitment websites. It also provides Dryg.pl, tailored for manual workers; Theprotocol.it, dedicated to IT professionals; and eRecruiter, a robust system for optimizing recruitment workflows. This Warsaw, Poland-based company was established in the year 2000.
